text: So I'm restructuring a help site and want a quick sitemap. Put Home at the top center. Docs, Blog, Faq and Contact go in a row under it, and the Api sits below Docs. Hmm wait, it's not that important, I would like Api smaller than the rest. Connect Home to Docs, Blog, Faq and Contact with plain lines. Then link Docs to Api with an arrow. Color the Faq pink and the Blog orange. Is the Faq next to the Blog? Tell me how many shapes are in the diagram and then list everything below Home. And if anything is not connected to Home, tell me which, I can't tell by eye.
Tiny test. Pin is red now. Mark it. Make the Pin a big circle. Is the Pin red? Put the Pin at the center.
Town plan. Shop right of the Bank, same level. Make the Bank a big gray rectangle. The Shop should be yellow. Link the Bank to the Shop. Is the Shop near the Bank?
Hospital ward. Make the beds white. Is Bed1 white? Put Bed1 at the left. Link Bed1 to Bed2 and Bed2 to Bed3.
Cooking. Make the Stew a big brown circle. Add 2 yellow squares and 3 orange circles. How many squares are there? How many circles are there now?
Web layout. the Side is smaller than the Main, I think. check? Make the Nav a huge blue rectangle. The Main should be a big white rectangle. Link the Nav to the Main. Put the Side at the right.
Art class. The Easel should have the label Studio. Make the Easel a big brown rectangle. Is the Easel brown? Put the Easel at the left.
Fishing trip plan. Make the Rod a big gray rectangle. The Reel should be a small black circle. Please connect rod to reel. Arrow both directions. thx. Is the Rod connected to the Reel now?

Food chain poster for the biology fair, I need it clean. Sun feeds Plant, Plant feeds Bee and Bee feeds Bird. Make it a chain. Make the Sun a huge yellow circle. Plant is green and Bee is yellow. Bird should be a big blue star. Is Bird reachable from Sun? Which shape is the most connected? Count the connections. Put Sun at the left. Put Bird at the right. How many stars do we have? Is the Bee smaller than the Bird? Rename Plant to Grass. Thanks a lot.

Hello! I've been struggling with the kitchen layout for our new place. Could you put the Chef at the center? The three machines, Oven, Grill and Fryer, should be around the Chef, so put each of them near the Chef. Make the Oven red, the Grill orange and the Fryer yellow, heat colours. The Fryer is a bit too close to the Grill, so move the Fryer 50 pixels to the right. Connect the Chef to each of the machines using dotted lines. Is the Chef the most connected one? Which machine is the farthest from the Chef? Thanks a bunch, you made my day.
Puzzle. Key should unlock Lock; connect them. Make the Key a small gold star. The Lock should be a big gray square. Is the Key near the Lock?
Tiny test. The O is small. Make the O red. Is the O red? Put the O at the center.
Bathroom floor. Four tiles, make a grid of them. Space them evenly in both directions, ideally. Make Tile1 white. Tile2 is blue. Link Tile1 to Tile2. Count the connections.
Board game. Add a red triangle named Dice at the center. Is the Dice red? Make the Snake green. Link the Snake to the Ladder.
School. Make the Exam a big red square. Is the Exam red? Rename the Exam to Test. wait, call it Quiz. Done.

Aquarium chart for the kids, they love sharks. What is the smallest one? Make the Whale a huge blue ellipse. The Shark should be a big gray triangle. Fish is orange. Link the Shark to the Fish. Is the Shark bigger than the Fish? Which shape is the biggest? How many ellipses are there? Put the Whale at the bottom. Put the Fish at the top. Rename the Fish to Nemo. Thanks.
Phone home screen. Make the Mail an ellipse and Chat a diamond. Make the Maps green. Is the Chat a diamond? Link the Mail to the Chat.
Movie poster. Is Hero left of Villain? Make the Hero a big blue star. The Villain should be black. Link the Hero to the Villain. Is the Hero bigger than the Villain?
Desk setup. A new shape: huge teal square, named Mat, at the bottom. Make the Lamp yellow. Is the Mat near the Lamp? Link the Lamp to the Mat.
Weekly schedule. I want the days in a column, please. Also set all of them to medium. Make Mon red and Tue green. Wed should be blue. Link Mon to Tue and Tue to Wed. Which day is the most connected?
Space sim. Move the Comet 300 pixels left. Make the Probe a small white circle. The Comet should be a big blue star. Link the Probe to the Comet. Is the Comet bigger than the Probe?

Home security. Make the Lock a big gray circle. The Door should be a brown rectangle. Link the Lock to the Door. Cut the line from the Lock to the Door. Never mind, leave it. Is the Lock connected to the Door?

Switch cabinet in the server room, I have to document it. Port1 links to Port2, and Port2 links to Port3. Is Port3 reachable from Port1? What about Port1 from Port3? Make Port1 green and Port2 yellow. Port3 should be red. Put Port1 at the left. Put Port3 at the right. Count the connections. Which port is the most connected? Is Port2 bigger than Port1? Make Port2 a huge square. Rename Port3 to Uplink. Thanks, that is it.
Craft box. Put the Glue in the back, Paper in the front. Make the Glue a small white circle. The Paper should be a big yellow rectangle. Link the Glue to the Paper.
Tiny test. Give Sq the label "hello world". Make the Sq green. Is the Sq a circle? Put the Sq at the bottom.
Lab chart. Make the Gene a big red square. Create a hexagon called Cell. Then a large circle called Tissue. Is the Gene red? How many circles are there?
Cousins. Make C1 pink, C2 pink, and C3 pink, since they're siblings. Link C1 to C2 and C2 to C3. Is C3 reachable from C1? Make C3 a big circle.

Okay, my tower defense map is falling apart and I need quick help. The Spawn is at the top left and the Gate at the bottom right. The three towers lie between them, on a diagonal. Not possible? Fine. Just put them in a row between Spawn and Gate. Hmm, one cannot put three shapes between two, I'll go without. Make the Gate large, red. Connect Spawn to Gate with a dashed line, that's the enemy path. Which tower is closest to the Gate? I need to know that. Also, how big is Tower2 compared to Tower3, bigger or smaller? Please make Tower1 a huge blue star while you're at it.
Biology lab. Put Neuron2 near Neuron1 and then connect them. Make Neuron1 a big yellow circle. Neuron2 should be a small orange circle. Is Neuron2 smaller than Neuron1?
Birthday. Is the Gift gold? Make the Gift a big red square. The Ribbon should be gold. Link the Ribbon to the Gift. Is the Ribbon near the Gift?
Zoo. Make Yak big and Goat tiny. Is the Yak bigger than the Goat? Link the Yak to the Goat.
Commute map. Home to Bus to Office. Chain. Make Home a big green circle. Office should be a big red square. The Bus is yellow. Is Office reachable from Home?
Office. Which shapes does the Desk neighbor? Make the Desk a huge brown rectangle. The Plant should be a small green circle. Link the Plant to the Desk.
Tiny test. Make the Ko a big circle. remove all circles. Thanks, that is all.

Train timetable for the club, please be patient with me. Make Express a big red star and Local a small blue circle. Done? Wait, hold on, I changed my mind about Local, make it green. Link the Express to the Local. Put the Express at the left. Put the Local at the right. Is the Express bigger than the Local? What color is the Local? How many stars are there? Count the connections. Is the Local right of the Express? Rename the Local to Slow. Thanks a lot.
Color test. Create a pink circle, a navy square and a lime triangle. How many shapes are there now? How many circles do we have? Thanks.

The principal asked me to prepare the classroom map for next year, and since I only have a few minutes please bear with me. There are six classes. Put Class1, Class2 and Class3 in a row at the top, and Class4, Class5 and Class6 in a row at the bottom. Hmm, that is the same as a grid, so arrange all six as a grid instead. Color the odd classes blue, so Class1, Class3 and Class5. The even ones should be green. Class6 is the big one with the stage, make it huge. Link Class6 to Class5 so students can walk through. Is there any other class that is connected to Class6? Count the green ones for me, I think it's three.
Power grid. Plant1 powers Plant2? Connect them, one way. Make Plant1 a big red square. Plant2 should be a small blue square. Is Plant2 smaller than Plant1?
Tiny test. place Mm at the bottom left. Make the Mm a big blue circle. Is the Mm blue?

Bakery. hmm which one is the rightmost? and what is rightOf the Cake? I mean right of. Make the Cake a big pink circle. The Pie is brown and the Tart is yellow. Link the Cake to the Pie. Link the Pie to the Tart.
Farm. Hen hen hen. Make the Hen a big red circle. Is the Hen red? Put the Hen at the center.

Literature map for my thesis, my advisor wants it by Monday. Paper1 cites Paper2 and Paper3. Paper3 cites Paper4. Draw arrows to show it. Which paper is the most connected? I would guess Paper3. Make Paper1 a big blue circle. Paper2 is green and Paper3 is orange. Paper4 should be a huge red star. Is Paper4 reachable from Paper1? How many connections are there? Put Paper1 at the left. Put Paper4 at the right. Is Paper3 bigger than Paper2? How many stars do we have? Rename Paper4 to Core. Thanks, wish me luck.
Team chart. Dev and Qa should be about the same size. Make Qa bigger. Make Dev a big blue circle. Qa is green. Link Dev to Qa. Count the connections.

Fairy tale map. Put a tiny black circle under the bridge named Troll. Make the River a huge blue rectangle. The Bridge should be a brown rectangle. Is the Troll near the Bridge? Link the Bridge to the River.
Tiny test. Is Box a rectangle? Is it blue? Make the Box a big green square. Is the Box green? Put the Box at the center.

Gym floor plan for the new club, the owner is picky. I'd love to see the Bike larger and gold. Also the Rower tiny. And the Treadmill stays as is. Make the Treadmill a big gray rectangle. The Bike should be a circle. Rower is blue. Link the Treadmill to the Bike and the Rower. Which machine is the most connected? How many connections are there? Put the Treadmill at the top. Put the Bike at the left. Put the Rower at the right. Is the Bike bigger than the Rower? Rename the Rower to Erg. Thanks, the owner will be happy.
Web hosting. Does the Origin reach the Cdn? Is there an arrow from Origin to Cdn? Make the Cdn a big blue circle. The Origin should be a big gray square. Link the Origin to the Cdn.
Classroom. Make the Board a huge black rectangle. Chalk below Board. Wait. Chalk to the right of Board. Make the Chalk a small white rectangle. Link the Chalk to the Board.
Notes. What colour is the Idea? What shape? How big? Make the Idea a big yellow star. What color is the Idea? Put the Idea at the top.

OK final message. Candy is red, Gum is pink, Cookie is brown and Cake is white. Then put them in a row. I want the Cake at the back and the Candy in front. Is the Gum next to the Cookie? Draw a plain line between Gum and Cookie if so. Add a huge yellow star called Prize at the top. Connect all four sweets to the Prize. Done! Goodbye.
